labeler: external (OWASP MASTG official challenge — Bernhard Mueller / Vantage Point Security)
scope: UnCrackable-Level1 stage-1 findings restricted to result_schema.json category enum (crypto/network/permission/intent/hardcoded/reflection_dynamic). Anti-tamper findings (root/debug detection) are out-of-scope at the current pipeline.
ground_truth_source: MASVS controls: MASVS-CRYPTO-1 (cryptographic key management), MASVS-STORAGE-2 (no sensitive data hardcoded), MASVS-STORAGE-3 (no sensitive data leaked via logs)

labels.notes: MASTG의 canonical hardcoded-key challenge. AES key (hex) + ciphertext (base64) 모두 verify 함수 안에 static literal로 박힘. APK reverse engineering으로 둘 다 추출 후 로컬에서 decrypt 시 secret 복원. Bernhard Mueller가 UnCrackable-Level1을 디자인할 때 의도한 1번 vulnerability.
Cipher.getInstance("AES") = ECB default. 우리 stage1 분석이 정확히 진단 (SecretKeySpec algorithm 인자가 실제 mode를 결정하지 않는 JCE 동작을 명시했음). MASTG 공식엔 hardcoded key가 1번 issue지만 ECB mode는 인접 finding으로 인정.
Log.d crypto error message — production build이라면 logcat을 통해 정보 누설. MASTG의 secondary finding으로 인정하나 LOW. 실제 production app이 아닌 데모 challenge라 우선순위 낮음.

out_of_scope_known_issues.reason: result_schema.json category enum에 anti-tamper 항목 없음. Future Work.

out_of_scope_known_issues.issue: Weak debugger detection (C0001b.m1a — only FLAG_DEBUGGABLE check, missing Debug.isDebuggerConnected at runtime)

out_of_scope_known_issues.reason: 위와 동일. 우리 stage1 negative confirmation으로 명시됨.

expected_pipeline_metrics.note: All in-scope findings are TP (UnCrackable was designed by OWASP to expose these exact vulnerabilities). Out-of-scope MASVS-RESILIENCE issues are tracked in `out_of_scope_known_issues` and contribute to the recall ceiling once anti-tamper category is added.
